text:
Date: Saltmarsh & Rye opened to the public on 14 March 2019.
Named person: Tobias Kellerman, licensing officer for the Harrowmere Borough Council, signed off the venue's food-service permit.
Figure: The dining room seats 46 guests, with a further 12 spaces on the riverside terrace.
Source document: The Harrowmere Borough Council Licensing Register, entry no. HB-2019-0317, lists Odile Ferrant as founding chef and permit holder.
